messages.content: 想像你是一位雕塑家，正在進行一個大型項目的工作。你有兩種不同密度的材料可供使用。第一種材料的密度為5.2克/立方公分，第二種材料的密度為7.8克/立方公分。你計劃創建兩個相同的圓錐體，每個的底面半徑為10公分，高度為30公分。第一個圓錐體將使用第一種材料製作，第二個圓錐體將使用第二種材料製作。你能計算出圓錐體的體積（四捨五入到小數點後兩位），然後根據它們各自的密度計算出每個圓錐體的質量嗎？

function.name: geometry_calculate_cone_volume
function.description: Calculate the volume of a cone given the radius and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: Radius of the cone base. This is a float type value.

height.description: Height of the cone. This is a float type value.

round_off.description: Number of decimal places to round off the answer.

function.name: physics_calculate_cone_mass
function.description: Calculate the mass of a cone given the radius, height, and density. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: Radius of the cone base. This is a float type value.

height.description: Height of the cone. This is a float type value.

density.description: Density of the material the cone is made of. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to calculate the volume of a cone with radius=10 cm, height=30 cm, rounded to two decimals. Then compute masses using densities 5.2 g/cm^3 and 7.8 g/cm^3 respectively.

We have tool functions: geometry_calculate_cone_volume(radius, height, round_off?) -> returns something. And physics_calculate_cone_mass(radius, height, density). We should use the tool calls. The user didn't specify rounding for mass; we can assume default or maybe round to two decimals too? They only asked to round volume to two decimals. For mass, they didn't specify rounding but likely want it as well. But we can just return raw values from tool. Let's call geometry_calculate_cone_volume twice? Actually same radius and height so one call suffices. Then call physics_calculate_cone_mass twice with different densities.

We'll do first call: geometry_calculate_cone_volume({radius:10, height:30, round_off:2}). Then second call: physics_calculate_cone_mass({radius:10,height:30,density:5.2}). Third call: physics_calculate_cone_mass({radius:10,height:30,density:7.8}). We'll output results nicely.
